dishes.name: Zesty Poppy Seed Yogurt
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with honey, lemon and poppy seeds
dishes.method: Stir the lemon zest, honey, and poppy seeds into the yogurt. Top with sunflower seeds.
dishes.why: A nod to the traybake the house is dreaming of, providing protein and healthy fats without nuts.

dishes.name: Savoury Beef and Rice Bowl
dishes.title: Minced beef with green beans and herby lemon rice
dishes.method: Combine a portion of the beef and green bean mix with the lemon rice in a bowl. Reheat in a pan until steaming and top with parsley.
dishes.why: A protein-rich bowl using the loud green beans and starch to fuel the afternoon.

dishes.name: Golden Roast Chicken and Broccoli
dishes.title: Roast chicken thighs and potatoes with steamed broccoli
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and potatoes in the oven. Steam the broccoli for 5 minutes and serve alongside.
dishes.why: A classic warm dinner with a loud vegetable and roasted starch.

dishes.name: Soft Boiled Eggs and Soldiers
dishes.title: Soft boiled eggs with buttered toast
dishes.method: Boil the eggs for 6 minutes. Toast the bread, butter it, and cut into strips for dipping.
dishes.why: A warm, simple breakfast that can be eaten easily while the kitchen is being painted.

dishes.name: Cold Roast Chicken Bowl
dishes.title: Sliced roast chicken and potato salad with greens
dishes.method: Slice the cold chicken and potatoes. Toss with salad leaves and olive oil in a bowl.
dishes.why: Easy to eat standing up or away from the dust-sheeted table.

dishes.name: Warm Beef and Rice Bowl
dishes.title: Beef, peppers and green beans over lemon rice
dishes.method: Reheat the beef and rice together in a pan. Serve in a bowl with hot sauce to taste.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting bowl that requires no table space and minimal cleanup.

dishes.name: Summer Berry Yogurt Bowl
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with fresh berries and seeds
dishes.method: Top the yogurt with berries and seeds.
dishes.why: Fresh and light for a summer morning, packed with protein.

dishes.name: Beef and Green Bean Stir-fry
dishes.title: Savoury beef and peppers with lemon rice
dishes.method: Flash-heat the beef and rice in a hot pan. Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice.
dishes.why: Using the final portions of the batch for a quick, high-protein lunch.

dishes.name: Crispy Salmon and Herby Rice
dishes.title: Pan-seared salmon with warm lemon rice and salad
dishes.method: Sear the salmon in a pan for 4 minutes per side. Reheat the remaining rice in a separate pan. Serve with salad.
dishes.why: A fresh fish dinner to end the stretch, with the rice providing the mandatory warm element.

preparations.title: Roast chicken thighs and new potatoes
preparations.method: Halve the potatoes. Toss chicken and potatoes with oil, oregano, salt, and pepper. Roast at 200°C for 45 minutes until golden.

preparations.title: Savoury beef with peppers and green beans
preparations.method: Brown the beef in a large pan. Add sliced peppers, green beans, and minced garlic. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp.

preparations.title: Herby lemon rice
preparations.method: Boil the rice until tender. Drain and stir in lemon juice and chopped parsley.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat oven. Prep chicken and potatoes, get them roasting. Start the rice boiling. While they cook, brown the beef and sauté with the peppers and beans. Chop the parsley and zest the lemons. Drain the rice and season. Once the chicken is done, box everything according to the weights.
